Eco

Category Furniture
Brand Roche Bobois
Year 2009

For Artelano, Ora-Ïto designed an ecological library made from recycled materials from certified forests. Its simple assembly is done without screws by simply fitting the different elements together. It cleverly references the 70s in the designer's characteristic style by combining the curve and the flat.
